findings.title: Deployment, promotion, and rollback are not proven
findings.root_cause: The repository contains CI smoke and staging-load gates but no authorized deployment target, release artifact registry linkage, signed promotion, or executed reversal drill.
findings.as_is: Local build and CI definitions exist; rollback anchor is a Git baseline only.
findings.to_be: A release job builds once, emits SBOM/attestation, promotes an immutable digest, runs post-deploy smoke/readiness, and executes a reversible rollback drill with retained evidence.
verification: Deployment artifact digest links to commit
post-deploy /readyz and authenticated MCP smoke pass
findings.rollback: Revert deployment to previous signed digest; preserve source baseline and evidence.

findings.title: Production identity gateway, explicit RBAC, and key rotation remain unproven
findings.root_cause: The current implementation proves single-user trusted-header/owner-token and principal/session binding, but no external identity authority or explicit production role/membership policy is evidenced.
findings.as_is: Local OAuth PKCE/device, HMAC subject binding, scopes, token subject, resource binding, and session binding pass.
findings.to_be: Identity gateway, role/permission matrix, key rotation, revocation propagation, and cross-tenant authorization are exercised in an authorized staging/production-like environment.
verification: Actor × Resource × Action × Context matrix passes
old signing key rejected after rotation
role denial and cross-tenant denial pass against real gateway
revocation and subject transfer remain fail-closed
findings.rollback: Revert identity configuration/key version using dual-key overlap and revoke compromised material.

findings.title: Hosted observability alert firing and recovery are not proven
findings.root_cause: Metrics, dashboards, alerts, readiness, and local monitor contracts exist, but no hosted Prometheus/Grafana scrape or notification path was available.
findings.as_is: Local contract proves required metrics/alerts/panels and no secret leak.
findings.to_be: A staging environment proves scrape, alert fire, notification, silence/acknowledgment, recovery, and runbook execution for auth-denial, latency, server-error, SQLite readiness, and idempotency ambiguity signals.
verification: Synthetic failure drives each P0/P1 alert
sanitized event and incident record retained
findings.rollback: Revert alert/dashboard config to prior version; disable only the failing rule with owner and expiry.

findings.title: Authorized real-server CSRF/XSS/SQLi probe is incomplete
findings.root_cause: The isolated Windows process did not bind the probe port; the failure was environmental and no exploit conclusion was inferred.
findings.as_is: Static scans, parameterization review, URL hardening tests, negative security matrix, and current positive E2E pass.
findings.to_be: A deterministic isolated server bootstrap exposes a health endpoint and runs the authorized probe with sanitized stdout/stderr and cleanup proof.
verification: no tool side effect after rejection
findings.rollback: No product rollback; discard isolated test roots/processes only.

findings.title: SBOM and signed build provenance are unavailable
findings.root_cause: CI installs/builds/tests/uploads evidence but does not prove a generated SBOM, signed attestation, immutable artifact digest, or promotion chain.
findings.as_is: Commit and local evidence hashes exist; GitHub-native provenance status is UNKNOWN.
findings.to_be: CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM and SLSA-compatible attestation are generated at build time, signed, uploaded, and verified before promotion.
verification: attestation verifies against commit and artifact digest
findings.rollback: Do not promote an artifact that lacks provenance; retain last signed release.

findings.title: Cross-OS chaos/Swarm and browser-host evidence remain incomplete
findings.root_cause: CI runs core smoke on three OSes but Swarm/chaos is Ubuntu-only and no browser-host visual/interaction trace is present.
findings.as_is: Local UI contract/accessibility tests and Ubuntu Swarm/chaos evidence pass; current source/E2E quality gates pass.
findings.to_be: Critical chaos/Swarm cases run or are risk-justified across supported OSes, and an authorized browser-host E2E captures functional/accessibility evidence.
verification: browser-host interaction trace and accessibility assertions pass
findings.rollback: Quarantine only failing environment job; do not weaken product gates or delete evidence.

findings.title: Write-to-ACK ambiguous interval remains for non-reversible process/stdin effects
findings.root_cause: Lease fencing protects finalization ownership but cannot prove whether an external process/stdin effect happened before a crash without a durable external acknowledgment.
findings.as_is: File/idempotency recovery and write_stdin sequence tests pass; ambiguity is retained rather than blindly retried.
findings.to_be: Process instances and stdin deliveries use durable ACK/fencing and reconciliation rules for non-reversible effects, with split-brain chaos evidence.
verification: Crash between write and ACK leaves explicit ambiguous state
findings.rollback: Keep ambiguous state pending/manual; never auto-replay non-reversible input after uncertain crash.

findings.title: Hosted load calibration and provider/runtime behavior are unknown
findings.root_cause: Wave 3/local sustained-load evidence exists, but no hosted regional calibration or external provider/model runtime was exercised.
findings.as_is: Local wave profiles and staging-load CI definition exist with sanitized latency/throughput evidence.
findings.to_be: Three calibration runs per region/tool establish p50/p95/p99, throughput, errors, 429/5xx, retry, timeout, and saturation thresholds.
findings.rollback: Stop load job and preserve prior SLO thresholds; do not promote uncalibrated thresholds to production.

findings.title: Explicit RBAC, key-rotation automation, and provenance automation backlog
findings.root_cause: The current single-user authorization model and local evidence path are intentionally bounded but not a full enterprise IAM/supply-chain control plane.
findings.as_is: Fail-closed server-side scopes/principal/session/resource binding and local evidence indexing exist.
findings.to_be: Versioned RBAC policy, dual-key rotation automation, SBOM/attestation pipeline, and audit reporting are codified.
verification: Policy tests, rotation rehearsal, SBOM/attestation verification, and evidence retention pass in CI.
findings.rollback: Retain previous policy/key/provenance workflow versions and require explicit approval for rollback.
